summary: What does continuation 5 measure for review configuration, and what turn budget should ERS-010 state as the product default?
detail: ERS-010 currently carries continuation 4's measurement on one frozen case: an arm capped at 40 responses per job stopped 11 of 12 jobs at the ceiling and reached 18 of the 110-finding union, while its own control at 160 responses finished all 12 using 37 to 110 responses per job and reached 45. Continuation 5 re-measures admissions as the bound on recall. The unit names continuation 4 as its run and states no product default turn budget; when continuation 5 reports, ERS-010 is re-adjudicated against it under the currentness rule in ERS-006. This is recorded as an open question rather than a placeholder in canon text.
raised_by: goal 3 launching instruction, 2026-09-17: continuation 5 has not reported

summary: What does continuation 5 measure for per-stage latency against the 75-minute target, and does the 60-to-75-minute per-topic target in ERS-012 hold?
detail: ERS-012 currently carries continuation 4's measurement: the full five-stage pipeline ran 6,378.3 seconds of wall time at average concurrency 2.620, with discovery 595.1 s, implementation 1,889.2 s, history 2,079.6 s, reconcile 3,699.3 s and compare 658.3 s, and three reconcile jobs cut at the 2,400-second per-job limit. That is 1 hour 46 minutes against a 60-to-75-minute target. Continuation 5 measures the review stages against a 75-minute target. When it reports, ERS-012 is re-adjudicated against it; until then the target stands as Jared's product target and the measured figures name continuation 4 as their run.

summary: When does the designated Plans agent add Plans/External_Research.md and Plans/Settings_System.md to Spec_Lock and plan_graph coverage, and Plans/Settings_System.md to sharding_config sources?
detail: This ledger's validator fails on three governance-coverage omissions and nothing else. Plans/External_Research.md was added to sharding_config sources by this branch, as the registration of a new owner document requires, but Spec_Lock and plan_graph coverage are reseal artifacts owned by the designated Plans agent and were not touched. Plans/Settings_System.md was already outside all three on origin/main and this branch did not change that. This is the same class the F106 to F109 landing recorded.

summary: Who adds the External Research consumer reference to the Jujutsu, Source Control and Backup owners that branch plans/c4-corrections-20260917 was holding?
detail: The launching instruction kept this branch apart from plans/c4-corrections-20260917 on the owner documents it was concurrently editing: Plans/Jujutsu_Integration.md, Plans/Source_Control_System.md, Plans/Backup_Restore_System.md, Plans/final_gui_interaction_contracts.schema.json and their fixtures. This branch edits none of those. It is not full disjointness: the two branches share eight changed paths against their common base, the six Plans/.plan_index files that both regenerate, scripts/pm-new-contracts-verify.py where the hunks are composable, and Plans/ledgers/v2/ledger_registry.json, which conflicts for whichever lands second and is resolved by keeping both ledger entries and the later updated_at_utc. Those owners are recipients of research findings under ERS-004 and ERS-006, and a one-line consumer reference pointing at Plans/External_Research.md belongs in each. It is recorded here as a follow-up rather than applied, so neither branch edits the other's files.
